public_theory_bridge.fact_1: CC-balanced formulas are contained in the SLUR tractable class.
public_theory_bridge.fact_2: A CNF belongs to SLUR only if the nondeterministic SLUR procedure never returns GIVE_UP over its legal variable/branch choices.
public_theory_bridge.certificate_rule: Therefore one replayable legal GIVE_UP execution is an exact finite certificate of NOT_SLUR and hence NOT_CC_BALANCED.
references: Franco and Weaver, Relative size of certain polynomial time solvable subclasses of satisfiability / SAT survey literature.
Schlipf et al., SLUR: A Propositional Prover That Never Gives Up on Satisfiable Instances, 1995.
Handbook of Satisfiability, history chapter: CC-balanced is subsumed by SLUR.

result.meaning: The CC-balanced direct P-lane is exactly excluded for every frozen R50G25X residual by a short replayable SLUR give-up trace.
result.not_meaning: This does not implement the general CC-balanced recognition algorithm and says nothing about other formulas.

scientific_interpretation.why_this_is_better_than_numerical_matrix: The negative certificate is purely Boolean/unit-propagation replay and requires no numerical LP or balanced-matrix decomposition implementation.
